title: Drug-induced Sensitization of Adenylyl Cyclase: Assay Streamlining and Miniaturization for Small Molecule and siRNA Screening Applications
protocol: Expand CHO-K1-DRD2L cells on a 15 cm² cell culture dish in Ham's F12 media supplemented with L-glutamine, G418, hygromycin, penicillin, streptomycin, and FBS until the cells are 90-95% confluent.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Harvest the cells by adding cell dissociation buffer for 5 min at 37 °C.
Resuspend the cells using culture media and count cells using trypan blue exclusion.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in freezing media.
Dilute the cell suspension to achieve a desired cell concentration (e.g., 1-20 x 10^6 cells/μl).
Aliquot 1.0 μl of cell solution to each cryovial.
Incubate the cryovials in a cell freezing container at -80 °C overnight.
Transfer the cryovials to a liquid N2 tank for long-term storage.
Rapidly thaw a frozen cryovial of cells in a 37 °C water bath.
Once cells are thawed, transfer them to a conical tube containing Opti-MEM and mix by inverting the tube 3-5 times.
Centrifuge the cells at 500 x g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 μl Opti-MEM.
Count the cells using trypan blue exclusion to determine cell viability.
Dilute viable cells as necessary (e.g., 3 x 10^5 cells/μl) in Opti-MEM.
Plate 10 μl/well of cells in a tissue culture treated 384-well plate using a multichannel pipette.
Make serial dilutions of cAMP in Opti-MEM to generate a standard curve for estimating cAMP production by the cells.
Add 10 μl/well of the cAMP standards to the plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 1 hr.
Prepare a solution of siRNA in RNase-free ddH2O (e.g., 0.4 pmol/μl).
Add 5 μl to individual wells of 384-well plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Dilute Lipofectamine 2000 in Opti-MEM by a factor of 0.006 (e.g., add 6 μl of Lipofectamine 2000 to 1,000 μl of Opti-MEM).
Mix the dilution by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the Lipofectamine 2000/Opti-MEM solution for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 5 μl of the diluted Lipofectamine 2000/Opti-MEM solution to individual wells of a 384-well plate containing siRNA.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Incubate the plate for 30 min at room temperature.
Plate assay ready cells as described above (Section 2).
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Return assay plate to a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 48-96 hr.
Dilute the drug of interest in Opti-MEM to 6x the desired final concentrations.
Add 2.5 μl/well of the test compound or buffer containing vehicle to the side of the wells using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature (incubation is optional).
Prepare a 600 nM solution of quinpirole in Opti-MEM.
Add 2.5 μl/well of the 600 nM quinpirole solution to the side of the wells using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 2 hr.
Prepare the stimulation solution in Opti-MEM containing 40 μM forskolin, 2 μM IBMX, and 4 μM spiperone.
Add 5 μl/well of the stimulation solution to the side of the wells using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hr.
Reconstitute anti-cAMP-cryptate and cAMP-d2 in distilled water according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Freeze aliquots of reconstituted solutions at -20 °C for short term storage.
Dilute one aliquot of anti-cAMP-cryptate in the lysis buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions to make a working solution.
Dilute one aliquot of cAMP-d2 in the lysis buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions to make a working solution.
Add 10 μl/well of the anti-cAMP-cryptate working solution and 10 μl/well of the cAMP-d2 working solution to the 384-well plate using a multichannel pipette.
Centrifuge the plate at 100 x g for 15 sec at room temperature.
Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hr.
Read the plate in a fluorescence plate reader (auto scale setting for sensitivity) using an excitation of 337 nm and measure emissions at 620 nm and 665 nm according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Apply ratiometric analysis to assess cAMP standard curve per manufacturers instructions.
Extrapolate the estimated cAMP accumulation in the test wells using data analysis software.
